tipo.title: Tender scope
tipo.description: "Convocatorias" (national) covers ordinary domestic public procurement. "Convocatorias Internacionales" is SICOES's own modality flag for processes also open to foreign bidders -- still run by Bolivian government entities.

entidad.title: Entity keyword (optional)
entidad.description: Free-text keyword to filter by purchasing government entity name (Spanish), e.g. 'Gobierno Autonomo Municipal'. Leave blank to include all entities.

objetoContrato.title: Object of contracting keyword (optional)
objetoContrato.description: Free-text keyword matched against the tender's object/description (Spanish), e.g. 'construccion' or 'medicamentos'. Leave blank to include all.

soloVigentes.title: Only currently open tenders
soloVigentes.description: When enabled (default, matches SICOES's own default), only tenders still accepting proposals are returned. Disable to include historical/closed processes too.

tiposContratacion.title: Contracting types
tiposContratacion.description: Which contracting-type categories to include. All four are selected by default, matching SICOES's own default.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Caps how many tender records this run returns. SICOES's own search page returns 10 rows per page server-side -- this actor pages through as many requests as needed up to this cap or until the result set is exhausted.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Datacenter proxies worked fine during recon (no country-specific geo-block observed), so no residential/country default is forced -- switch to Bolivia-geolocated Residential if you see unexplained blocks.
